blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States—US air regulators on Friday issued a rare nationwide ground stop for all departing flights, citing a communications problem affecting air traffic control towers. This move caused immediate confusion for travelers. The Federal Aviation Administration “issued a nationwide ground stop for all US airports following a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers,” the agency said. “FAA technicians are investigating the issue.” The FAA has announced similar orders in recent years on individual airlines due to communications issues, usually lasting a couple of hours or less.
